patthana23.42:1.1: na sanidassanasappaṭigho na upādinnupādāniyo dhammo anidassanaappaṭighassa upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo:. ārammaṇe cha.
patthana23.42:2.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na anupādinnupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekavīsa.
patthana23.42:3.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na anupādinnaanupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nasanidassanattika nasaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikattike sanidassanattika saṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikattikaṃ
